message:
We were in the middle of a family hike last weekend when my phone decided it was time to call it quits—battery dead, just like that! As we stood there, surrounded by nature and just a little lost, I realized how much we rely on our gadgets for everything. 

In that moment, it hit us: it’s not just about having a fully charged phone, but also about being prepared with the basics. We spent the rest of the day talking about what we could pack in our go-bags: a good old-fashioned map, some extra snacks, and a trusty flashlight. 

Sometimes, it’s the simplest things that keep us grounded. What’s in your go-bag? 🌲
